title: Fosterton / SW Saskatchewan Heavy Gathering - South Saskatchewan System (Plains)
dek: One Plains heavy system drains the Fosterton country of SW Saskatchewan to Regina: gathering lines feed a 16-inch mainline east to the PMC Regina Terminal, which delivers into the Enbridge Mainline at Regina and to local markets. Capacity and current throughput are not publicly disclosed; the honest numbers on this sheet are the system's dimensions and its dated history.
